about.heading: Hi, I'm Ankita.
paragraphs: I'm a luxury travel advisor with Fora, and hotels are my whole thing. Accor, Marriott, Hyatt, IHG, Hilton, Four Seasons, Anantara: I know which properties are worth it, which rooms to ask for, and which partner programmes (Marriott STARS and Luminous, Hyatt Privé, Accor Heartist and more) unlock perks you can't get on Expedia or the hotel's own site.

You pay the hotel's own rate. I add the breakfast, the credit, the upgrade and a hotel team that knows you're arriving. Your loyalty points and elite nights still count, because the booking is treated as direct. Nvoy doesn't charge you a fee; the hotels pay me.
Send me a destination, rough dates, a nightly budget and who's travelling. I'll come back with a shortlist and the exact perks for those dates.

faq.q: How is Nvoy different from booking on Expedia or the hotel's website?
faq.a: Expedia and most websites don't have access to the exclusive luxury programmes (Marriott STARS and Luminous, Hyatt Privé, Accor Heartist and others). Booking through Nvoy gets you those perks: free nights, $100 credits, room upgrades, breakfast, at the same rate the hotel publishes.

faq.q: Which hotel chains do you work with, and do you charge a fee?
faq.a: The world's leading chains: Marriott, Hyatt, IHG, Accor, Hilton, Anantara, Four Seasons and many more. For hotel bookings Nvoy charges no service fee. The hotel compensates me directly, so you get the VIP perks at no extra cost.

faq.q: Will I still earn my hotel loyalty points?
faq.a: Yes. Unlike many third-party sites, bookings made through Nvoy are considered direct by the hotels. You earn elite night credits and loyalty points exactly as if you'd booked on their app, and you get the perks on top.

Use the form below, or message me on WhatsApp or Instagram with your destination (and hotel, if you have one in mind), preferred dates, nightly budget and number of guests. I'll send a quote showing the exact perks available for those dates.
